geometry_edits: Rebuilt the structural shell from all 16 distinct vertices of official FID 225 while preserving the existing asset object, collection, scene, ID and library path.

Cut the repeating window bays into the wall surfaces, with recessed glazing, divided panes, stone surrounds, floor bands, plinth and coping; added a portable procedural brick material with UV courses and bump detail.

Added a west-facing service/access entry hypothesis, divided door leaves, a restrained canopy and approach treads. Its orientation is informed by the address and a Purdue project-blog reference to a service door off Third Street; exact facade and main entrance remain unverified.

Added two interior floor plates, approximate circulation partitions, generic administrative workstations, meeting tables, chairs, storage and planters. The fuller open-office layout is explicitly schematic and does not claim an as-built plan.
Rendered exterior, west-side entry, roof-open upper-floor and ground-floor review views; previews use temporary cameras, lights and ground that are not saved into the library.
uncertainties: The official campus GIS polygon is not a certified survey and publishes no position or dimension uncertainty.
The GIS reports two levels. Modeled total height of 7.6 m remains an estimate; no measured elevation was located.
The archive documents a 1982 addition but supplies no drawing to separate the original and added footprint areas.

Facade material has broad brick-photo support, but facade color, window spacing, roof form and exact entrance location remain approximate. The west-side service/access hypothesis is supported only directionally by the Third Street address and a 2015 Purdue project-blog note; it is not verified as the main entrance. No elevation photo with a clear full facade or measured architectural drawing was located.

Interior partitions, open-office arrangement, room assignments, doors and furniture are conceptual because no public floor plan was located. The schematic furniture is included to communicate administrative use and scale, not as-built placement.
Independent grading and master-blend integration are pending.
